questionText: What is the Spring ecosystem and how does Spring Boot relate to it?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can map Framework, Boot, Data, Security, Batch, and Cloud to their separate responsibilities and assemble only the projects an application needs.
outOfScope: Assuming every microservice requires Spring Cloud

claims.statement: Boot dependency management, starters, and conditional auto-configuration help assemble compatible Spring ecosystem projects without making those projects part of Spring Framework.
Adding a starter enables an integration path, but the application still owns its domain model, credentials, access policy, and vendor-specific settings.

examples.title: Order service using Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, and Spring Security

validation.expected: Each annotation and abstraction is attributed to its owning Spring project

visuals.title: Application connected to Framework and separate ecosystem projects with Boot assembling them

notes: The earlier diagram incorrectly placed Spring MVC beneath Boot; the revised diagram keeps MVC under Framework and Data, Security, Batch, and Cloud as separate project choices.

review.notes: The ownership model was checked against official Spring project and Boot documentation. Mermaid rendered successfully; final code fixture and editorial review remain open.
